files.description: Two-instance p2p sharing suite: instance A (BASE_URL, seeded library) grants; instance B (PEER_URL, empty peer) browses and pulls. Covers device identity and hub-disconnected state, LAN pairing via code, media-dir/folder/album grants, the album Share modal's checked grant and unchecked revoke flow, album Shared chips and peer-name header, the remote gallery (facet filters, live previews, URL-carried selection), background pull batches, the no-download-directory notice, grant revocation, device revocation and deletion, and duplicate-grant dedupe.

testContext: ENVIRONMENT: requires the two-instance sandbox (npm run isolatedEnvironment:start:sharing → A:5002 seeded, B:5003 empty peer; both p2p-enabled, hub unreachable ws://127.0.0.1:9, LAN/mDNS pairing only). Run with BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5002 PEER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5003. THE SUITE IS STATEFUL AND ORDERED (test.describe.configure mode 'default'): pairing/grants/download-dir persist server-side and each run assumes a PRISTINE sandbox — restart the environment before re-running; individual tests are not standalone. `page` is A; `pageB` is created per test via browser.newContext({ baseURL: PEER_URL }). Timeout is raised to 90s in beforeEach (pairing + transfers are live p2p calls). SELECTORS: settings strip `.device-status-strip code.device-id`; pairing uses 'Generate pairing code', `#pairing-code-box .pairing-code-text`, and `.accept-pairing-form textarea[name=code]`. Toasts are `.notification.visible`. Destructive actions use `#global-confirm-dialog.active` and `#confirm-dialog-confirm`, not native dialogs. Outbound grants are `.sharing-shares-nav .sharing-share-nav-item`; inbound grants are htmx-loaded under `#sharing-sidebar-shared-with-me` and need reload polling. Grant-form selects are hidden searchable-selects. Remote-gallery cards are `.remote-photo-card[data-select-id]`; selection is URL-backed (`select_id`, or `select=all&exclude_id`), and `#transfers-panel` self-polls until `.transfer-batch[data-state=completed]`. Album sharing: `#share-album-button` opens `#shareAlbumModal`; trusted devices are `input[name=device_id]`, checked exactly for active grants. Submit checked to grant and unchecked to revoke. The album header's `.page-header .subtitle .chip-accent` must equal the peer display name; the album sidebar and overview render `Shared` chips; Sharing settings names the outbound row `Seeded Album`. The modal-toggle scenario follows the dynamic-membership album scenario, which leaves membership at three and revokes its grant, and it revokes its own grant before general media-dir revocation.
explanation: 2026-07-18: Added and verified sharing_album_share_modal_toggle after moving the paired-device acceptance criteria from specs/albums.yaml to specs/sharing.yaml. The scenario proves the modal lists the trusted peer, starts unchecked after the prior album grant cleanup, grants when checked, renders the exact peer name in the album header plus Shared chips in the sidebar/overview, lists Seeded Album under Shared With Others, reopens checked, and revokes when unchecked with all indicators removed. Full ordered suite passed 12/12 against a fresh two-instance sandbox in 3.3 minutes; the tightened scenario also passed alone against the suite's final re-paired state. TypeScript validation passes.
